prediction_scope: collision table only; conditional severity prediction

hard_fail_rules.schema: exact D4 schema and column order required
hard_fail_rules.row_count: must match the frozen D4 row count
hard_fail_rules.collision_index: must be nonmissing and globally unique
hard_fail_rules.target: must be nonmissing and restricted to 0, 1, 2
hard_fail_rules.date_year: meta_date must parse and match meta_collision_year
hard_fail_rules.categorical_features: must be nonmissing because official unknown/not-applicable values are explicit labels
hard_fail_rules.speed_limit: nonmissing values must be one of 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70

row_retention.duplicates: do not auto-delete; fail and investigate if collision identifiers repeat
row_retention.unknown_categories: retain all records and explicit official categories
row_retention.rare_categories: retain at D5; do not pool using the full dataset

split_aware_category_policy.fit_scope: fit category vocabulary on each training partition only
split_aware_category_policy.rare_regular_categories: if pooling is used, map training categories below the threshold to __RARE__ using training counts only
split_aware_category_policy.official_unknown_or_not_applicable: retain the original semantic label in frozen data and exempt it from generic rare pooling when observed in training; if absent from training, the model encoder maps it to __UNSEEN__ while the audit preserves the original label
split_aware_category_policy.latest_year_check: 2018-2023 versus 2024 is diagnostic only; D6 freezes the final temporal split

missing_value_policy.multinomial_logistic: fit numeric imputation within each training fold only
missing_value_policy.ordered_logit: fit numeric imputation within each training fold only

class_imbalance_policy.D5: no over-sampling, under-sampling, class weighting or synthetic data
class_imbalance_policy.primary_modeling: class weights are computed from each training partition only
class_imbalance_policy.SMOTENC: optional sensitivity analysis only and training-fold only

feature_selection: use only the exact feature_columns allowlist in the frozen schema
